details.content:
You wake up with a pounding headache. The smell of ale and sawdust fills your nostrils.

You're lying on a rough wooden floor, surrounded by empty tankards and sleeping patrons.
The tavern is dimly lit by a few flickering candles. Your memory is hazy...

How did you get here? What happened last night?

session_events.description: Perception Check: Stand up and look around

details.outcome: Your head is still spinning. You can't make out much in the dim light. The bartender glances at you but says nothing.

details.content:
As you're trying to make sense of things, a cloaked figure approaches your table.

'You're awake,' they say in a low voice. 'Good. We need to talk. But not here.'

They slide a note across the table and disappear into the shadows before you can respond.

[bold]The Note:[/bold]

'You were chosen for a reason. Meet me at the old mill outside town at midnight. Come alone, or don't come at all. Your life depends on it.

- The Shadow'

The note is signed with the same symbol you saw earlier: a crescent moon with a dagger.

session_events.description: Follow the note - Go to the old mill

details.ending:
[bold]To Be Continued...[/bold]

You decide to follow the note. As you leave the tavern, you feel eyes watching you.
The old mill awaits. What secrets does it hold?

Your adventure has just begun.
